title: DRA-SAM: Disagreement-Driven Referential Active SAM for Low-Altitude Drone Referring Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2610.33057v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Referring segmentation in low-altitude drone imagery requires distinguishing small, visually similar instances under complex linguistic and spatial constraints. Global inference may yield multiple plausible masks or leave the intended referent insufficiently represented, motivating selective local re-inference. We propose DRA-SAM, a disagreement-driven framework that allocates an additional inference pass according to competing referential hypotheses and an unresolved state. A lightweight EvidenceScorer estimates beliefs over existing candidates and the unresolved state. A training-free Referential Disagreement LOOK policy balances belief-weighted candidate competition and unresolved-region coverage to select a crop for local re-inference. translated_abstract: 低空无人机图像中的指代分割需要在复杂的语言和空间约束下区分细小且视觉相似的实例。全局推理可能产生多个合理的掩码，或者使目标指代对象的表达不充分，这促使我们进行选择性的局部重新推理。我们提出了DRA-SAM，这是一个分歧驱动的框架，根据相互竞争的指代假设和未解决状态来分配额外的推理过程。轻量级的EvidenceScorer对现有候选对象和未解决状态估计信念。免训练的Referential Disagreement LOOK策略在信念加权的候选竞争与未解决区域覆盖之间进行平衡，以选择用于局部重新推理的裁剪区域。经过基准适配的同一SAM3-I骨干网络处理所选区域，产生的证据会更新现有假设并引入新的候选对象。在所比较的方法中，DRA-SAM取得（摘要原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 提出分歧驱动的DRA-SAM框架，利用证据评分器和免训练的Referential Disagreement LOOK策略，在低空无人机指代分割中对模糊候选和未解决区域进行选择性局部重推理，从而更好地区分细小且视觉相似的目标。
en_tdlr: DRA-SAM is a disagreement-driven framework that combines a lightweight EvidenceScorer with a training-free Referential Disagreement LOOK policy to perform selective local re-inference, resolving ambiguity among competing referential hypotheses for low-altitude drone referring segmentation of small, visually similar instances.
